description: This file contains unit tests for the KafkaPublisherActor component, verifying message publishing via Kafka, handling acknowledgements, and error cases.

classes.name: KafkaPublisherActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for KafkaPublisherActor, extending AbstractPublisherActorTest to evaluate Kafka message publishing and error handling.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock Kafka producer with successful send behavior.

methods.name: setUpMocksToFailWith
methods.description: Configures the mock Kafka producer to simulate a failure exception during send.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props configuration for KafkaPublisherActor without debugging enabled.

methods.name: getPublisherActorPropsWithDebugEnabled
methods.description: Provides Props configuration for KafkaPublisherActor with debugging enabled.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a message was published correctly with the expected topic, key, payload, and headers.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies message publishing in reply target scenario.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgements received have the expected status code and label.

methods.name: shouldContainHeader
methods.description: Helper to verify presence of a specific header in published Kafka records.

methods.name: testSendFailure
methods.description: Helper to verify behavior when Kafka send fails with specific exception, ensuring proper acknowledgements and error handling.
